levels.R2: paper plus printed/attached code static audit completed
levels.R3: API or local-code smoke test completed
levels.R6: independent reimplementation without directly copying author code reaches similar conclusions
levels.R7: method successfully transfers to a new/variant/independent problem

rules: Use the highest fully evidenced level only.
Visual audit is recorded separately and never raises R-level.
Missing source code, original data, or original PDF must be explicit.
Synthetic contract replay alone does not upgrade author-code reproduction level.
